Overview of the app

Tap a tab to read the brief. A rental business with a clear passion, a new app to replace its website, and a family who has never done this before.

User persona

A small business owner and working mom who needs fast, close to perfect solutions to balance work with family life.

meet MELINDA Jones

“How can I easily find and book a jet ski and snowmobile that can accommodate kids as second drivers?”

    Story board

    How a family goes from screens and boredom to a snowmobile and jet ski, and looking for information in the app. Hover a scene, tap to enlarge, or press play to follow the story.

    Competitive analysis

    The three competitors have very different features but similar success in conversion, so no special skills are needed to succeed. The chance for NXR is to bring it close to perfect and engage kids in this type of sport. Filter the criteria, and tap a competitor to hide it.

    User flow diagram

    Simple navigation from login: watch tutorials, ask questions, choose the right vehicle, add options, pay, confirm arrival, return the vehicle and earn points. Tap any step to open that screen in the live prototype.

    Brand guide

    Simple but elegant, with primitive drawings kids and families recognise. Blues stand for technology, metal, strength and cold weather. Warm colours stand for entertainment, fun, summer and energy.
